name: Toll the Dead
description: Point at a creature and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air; it must succeed on a Wisdom save or take necrotic damage, which is greater if it is missing any hit points.
dmg roll: 1d8 necrotic (1d12 if target is missing hit points)
higher_spellslot_benefit: At 5th, 11th, and 17th level: 2d8/3d8/4d8 (or 2d12/3d12/4d12 if the target is missing hit points).
